description: Audits names. Pass `names`, one per line; use slashes for paths or two-space indentation for nesting. Classifies each segment as kebab, snake, camel, Pascal, upper snake, title words or lower words and reports the dominant style and strays, then flags default tool names (Frame 12, Group 4, Rectangle), draft or version markers (final, copy, new, v2), names that repeat or differ only by case or separator, stray whitespace, emoji and file-unsafe characters, names over 40 characters, depth beyond 5 levels, mixed path separators and inconsistent state casing. It flags inconsistency, not which style is right. Works on the pasted names only.

names.description: One layer, component or token name per line.

name: check_naming_conventions
title: Naming convention check
